report_name: CISA Head: Recent Tech Outages Highlight Need for Broader Resilience

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
identities.description: U.S. government agency whose acting director, Nick Andersen, commented on the need for operational resilience against all disruptions, not just malicious cyber incidents.

identities.name: Nick Andersen
identities.description: Acting director of CISA who spoke at the FedTalks conference on November 17, 2026, about the need for system resilience.

identities.name: Microsoft
identities.description: Technology company whose Microsoft Outlook service experienced a global failure, which was cited by CISA as an example of a disruptive technology outage highlighting the need for resilience.
